title: Secure Login
description: A lightweight and secure authentication plugin for Paper servers with register/login protection, inventory locking, login timeout, and advanced player restrictions.
body:
[![Secure Login](https://www.image2url.com/r2/default/images/1783098291644-6a355862-ed57-4912-a769-0efb57c0a55a.png)](https://zn9ik.netlify.app/)
# 🔐 SecureLogin

**Standalone login-protection plugin for Paper 26.1.x** — locks players out of gameplay the instant they join, and hands full control back the moment they log in. No other plugin required to work.

---

## ✨ Features

- 🎒 **Inventory frozen** — hotbar, armor, offhand & cursor snapshotted on join, restored on login
- 👻 **Entities hidden** — players, mobs, animals, item frames, dropped items & more, invisible until login
- 🧊 **Movement & combat locked** — no walking, jumping, sneaking, or taking/dealing damage pre-login
- 🚫 **Interactions disabled** — inventory clicks, crafting, and GUIs blocked outright
- 💬 **Chat & commands blocked** — only `/login` and `/register` work pre-auth
- 🔑 **Built-in accounts** — bcrypt-hashed passwords, works out of the box, no external auth plugin needed
- ⏱️ **Login timeout** — auto-kick players who don't log in within a configurable time
- ♻️ **Reload/restart safe** — no lingering broken states after a server restart

---

## 📥 Installation

1. Drop `SecureLogin-1.0.0.jar` into your `plugins/` folder
2. Restart the server
3. Done — players register with `/register <password> <confirm>`, then log in with `/login <password>`

---

## 🕹️ Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/register <password> <confirm>` | Create an account |
| `/login <password>` | Log into your account |
| `/securelogin <reload\|status\|unlock>` | Admin command |

## 🛡️ Permissions

| Permission | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `securelogin.admin` | op | Use admin commands |
| `securelogin.bypass` | op | Bypass all login restrictions |

---

## 📋 Requirements

- Paper 26.1.x
- Java 25
